about_the_game:
The grand cosmic structures and the ceaseless interstellar fleets conceal the dark side of civilization. Behind the brilliance, countless unnoticed "nonentities" bear the truth of civilization's operation. As a business investigator hustling for the company, you will confront these unspeakable deals and secret missions. Fieldwork is perilous, and you must compete with various factions, using all means to secure benefits for yourself and the company.

Battles Between Interstellar Fleets

In this world, the way to resolve conflicts is simple and direct: if negotiations fail, resort to violence! Optimize your fleet's combat power through strategic formations and use advanced modules to completely transform starship functions. Fleet battles can be precisely controlled manually or handed over to an intelligent system for automatic management, helping you defeat enemies with minimal sacrifice.

You can freely decide the equipment configuration for field tasks, including operational functions, combat cores, and the scale of the rented fleet. The more streamlined the equipment, the greater the rewards. Additionally, purchase a private fleet to prioritize the company's assets in battle, secretly strengthening your own power.

Light Resource Strategy Gameplay

The core goal of the company is to make money, and the value of rare items far exceeds that of the fleet itself. How to allocate resources is key to your survival in this gloomy corner. In field tasks, you can flexibly choose to pocket funds or prioritize enhancing combat power; you can also decisively liquidate rare items for quick short-term gains.

 

When a mission fails, escaping is not shameful. You can abort the mission at any time to minimize losses; although you will lose part of the bonus, preserving your strength is paramount. After the battle, return to the space station to manage your resources, purchase new modules, strengthen your fleet, or simply enjoy a moment of leisure to prepare for the next departure.

Dark Humor in Galactic Daily Life

In a gloomy world, finding joy in hardship is the only way to survive. During missions, you will face various absurd and bizarre events, experiencing hilariously ironic storylines. This dark humor is not only a form of satire but also a way to understand the daily life in these gloomy corners of the galaxy. When the mission ends, you can return to the space station, have a drink with other down-and-out individuals, and share stories about the oddities of fieldwork. We are all lost souls in this vast world; why not chat for a while?

content_descriptors.notes: Pain caused by common space diseases and drugs used to treat them. Psychological problems caused by social pressure and common means of counseling. Financial related illegal acts and their legal consequences. These topics are addressed in the story, but not directly in the gameplay.

name: Nonentity Galaxy

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+ (32/64 bits)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU, 1 GB VRAM/ AMD HD5750 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimal resolution: 1280*720
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+ (32/64 bits)
  • Processor: Core i3 2,5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU, 2 GB VRAM / GTX 750ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended resolution: 1920x1080

short_description: Nonentity Galaxy is a rouge-lite light strategy game that includes starship battles, asset management, and dark humor. You will play as a business investigator who seeks profits for the company, dealing with the worst things you can expect... Thankfully you have your buddies :)
